name: San Diego competition 2007
information:
The price of the competition is $5 for preregistered and $10 for not preregistered.
Preregistration ends May 19. Send an e-mail to [Adam Zamora](mailto:mistizo858@hotmail.com) for preregistration.
On-site registration will be from 9:00 till 10:00 and competition starts at 10am.
